chest.name: Barbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Arch slightly, feet flat. Bar touches lower chest, drive up. The king of chest mass.

chest.name: Incline Barbell Press
chest.tip: 30–45° bench. Builds the upper chest shelf. Bar to upper chest.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: Upper chest focus. Lower until elbows dip just below bench level.

chest.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Deeper stretch than barbell. Press dumbbells together at the top.

chest.name: Decline Barbell Press
chest.tip: Hits the lower chest. Slight 15–30° decline. Often skipped but effective.

chest.name: Machine Chest Press
chest.tip: Beginner friendly and safe. Fixed path lets you push to failure.

chest.name: Cable Chest Fly
chest.tip: High cables, slight elbow bend. Squeeze hard at the center.

chest.name: Dumbbell Flat Fly
chest.tip: Go light, arc motion. Feel the deep chest stretch at the bottom.

chest.name: Pec Deck (Machine)
chest.tip: Pure chest isolation. Squeeze and hold one second at peak contraction.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.tip: Body in a straight line, elbows at 45°. Add a plate on your back to progress.

chest.name: Incline Push-Ups
chest.tip: Hands on a bench. Easier regression — great for beginners building up.

chest.name: Chest Dips
chest.tip: Lean torso forward, flare elbows out to bias the chest. Control the descent.

chest.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
chest.tip: Set the bench so the bar tracks to the mid-chest. Keep shoulders pinned and use the fixed path to train close to failure.

chest.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
chest.tip: Adjust the seat so handles line up with the upper chest. Keep your back in contact with the pad throughout.

chest.name: Plate-Loaded Chest Press
chest.tip: Brace against the pad, control the deep stretch, then press without letting the shoulders roll forward.

chest.name: Cable Crossover
chest.tip: Use a staggered stance and bring the handles together in a wide arc. Keep a soft elbow and squeeze the chest at the finish.

chest.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
chest.tip: Start handles near the hips and sweep toward eye level. Keep the ribs down so the upper chest, not the lower back, does the work.

chest.name: Dumbbell Pullover
chest.tip: Keep a slight elbow bend and lower only as far as the shoulders stay comfortable. Pull the dumbbell back over the chest with control.

chest.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: Use a shallow decline and keep the dumbbells controlled at the bottom. Press up and slightly together without letting the shoulders roll forward.

back.name: Deadlift
back.tip: Bar over mid-foot, neutral spine. Push the floor away. Biggest strength builder.

back.name: Barbell Row
back.tip: Hinge ~45°, pull bar to navel. Squeeze shoulder blades. Back stays flat.

back.name: Pendlay Row
back.tip: Each rep starts dead on the floor. Explosive pull, strict torso. Power builder.

back.name: T-Bar Row
back.tip: Neutral grip, drive elbows back. Great for mid-back thickness.

back.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
back.tip: Row to your hip, not your shoulder. Elbow tracks close. Full stretch at bottom.

back.name: Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Wide grip for width. Lean back slightly, pull to upper chest, full stretch up top.

back.name: Seated Cable Row
back.tip: Sit tall, pull to belly button, hold the squeeze one second. Vary the grip.

back.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
back.tip: Dead hang at the bottom, chest to bar. The best exercise for lat width.

back.name: Chin-Up
back.tip: Underhand grip hits lats and biceps. Full range, control the lowering.

back.name: Inverted Row
back.tip: Bar in a rack at hip height. Body straight, pull chest to bar. Beginner pull-up builder.

back.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
back.tip: Arms stay straight, pull bar to thighs. Pure lat isolation and mind-muscle connection.

back.name: Back Extension
back.tip: Hinge at the hips on the bench. Squeeze glutes at the top. Strengthens the lower back.

back.name: Barbell Shrug
back.tip: Shrug straight up to your ears, pause at the top. Builds the traps. No rolling.

back.name: Face Pulls
back.tip: Cable at eye height, pull to forehead with elbows high. Essential for shoulder health.

back.name: Chest-Supported Row (Machine)
back.tip: Keep the chest planted on the pad and pull elbows toward your hips. The support removes momentum and makes the back do the work.

back.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
back.tip: Set a low incline bench, let the arms hang long, then row toward the hip pockets without lifting your chest from the pad.

back.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Use parallel handles and drive elbows down toward the ribs. Pause at the bottom before returning to a full overhead stretch.

back.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Keep the torso tall and pull the attachment to the upper chest. Let the shoulder blades rise at the top for a complete range.

back.name: Machine High Row
back.tip: Set the seat so the handles start above shoulder height. Pull elbows down and back, keeping the chest against the pad.

back.name: Machine Low Row
back.tip: Reach forward under control, then row toward the lower ribs. Avoid rocking the torso to move extra weight.

back.name: One-Arm Cable Row
back.tip: Stand or kneel square to the cable and pull the elbow toward the hip. Resist twisting as the arm reaches forward.

back.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
back.tip: Choose assistance that lets every rep start from a dead hang. Drive elbows down and reduce assistance over time.

back.name: Dumbbell Shrug
back.tip: Let the bells hang at your sides, elevate the shoulders straight up, and pause briefly. Do not roll the shoulders.

back.name: Rack Pull
back.tip: Set the bar just below the knees, brace hard, and drive the hips through. Keep the bar close as you lock out.

legs.name: Barbell Back Squat
legs.tip: Bar on upper traps, chest up. Knees track toes. Hip crease below knees. King of exercises.

legs.name: Front Squat
legs.tip: Bar on front delts, elbows high. Stays more upright — heavy quad emphasis.

legs.name: Goblet Squat
legs.tip: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Easiest squat to learn — perfect for beginners.

legs.name: Leg Press (Machine)
legs.tip: Feet shoulder-width, press through heels. Don't lock the knees at the top.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlift
legs.tip: Push hips BACK, not down. A hip hinge — feel the hamstring stretch. Back neutral.

legs.name: Walking Lunges
legs.tip: Big step forward, front shin vertical, back knee nearly touches the floor. Step through.

legs.name: Reverse Lunges
legs.tip: Step backward instead of forward — easier on the knees. Drive through the front heel.

legs.name: Dumbbell Lunges
legs.tip: Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Stationary or walking. Adds load to the basic lunge.

legs.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
legs.tip: Rear foot on a bench, front foot forward. Brutal but one of the best quad/glute builders.

legs.name: Step-Ups
legs.tip: Step onto a bench, drive through the heel. Don't push off the back leg.

legs.name: Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: 3-second negative. Don't let your hips rise off the pad. Full range for hamstring health.

legs.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
legs.tip: Pause and squeeze the quad at the top. Don't go too heavy — feel the contraction.

legs.name: Hip Thrust
legs.tip: Upper back on a bench, bar over hips. Drive hips up, squeeze glutes hard at the top.

legs.name: Glute Bridge
legs.tip: Floor version of the hip thrust. Squeeze glutes at the top, pause one second.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
legs.tip: Full stretch at the bottom, pause and squeeze at the top. Calves need high reps.

legs.name: Seated Calf Raises
legs.tip: Bent knee targets the soleus. Slow tempo, full range, controlled stretch.

legs.name: Wall Sit
legs.tip: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor. Hold and breathe. Burns the quads.

legs.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
legs.tip: Keep the whole back against the pad, lower under control, and drive through the mid-foot. Do not let the hips curl under at depth.

legs.name: Smith Machine Squat
legs.tip: Place feet slightly ahead of the bar path so you can sit down between your heels. Keep the knees tracking over the toes.

legs.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
legs.tip: Use a staggered stance beneath the bar, lower the back knee straight down, and keep most pressure through the front foot.

legs.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
legs.tip: Brace the handles lightly, sit between the heels, and use the deep knee bend for quads without loading the spine.

legs.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: Line the knee with the machine pivot and keep the hips pressed into the pad. Curl smoothly and lower for two to three seconds.

legs.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: Lock the thigh pad down, start from a long hamstring stretch, and keep the hips seated as you curl.

legs.name: Standing Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: Brace the working thigh on the pad, curl the heel toward the glute, and avoid rotating the pelvis.

legs.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
legs.tip: Sit tall, open the knees under control, and pause at the widest comfortable position. Keep the torso still.

legs.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
legs.tip: Start with a comfortable stretch, draw the pads together smoothly, and return without bouncing at the stack.

legs.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
legs.tip: Keep ribs down and extend from the hip rather than arching the back. Squeeze the glute for a beat at full extension.

legs.name: Cable Pull-Through
legs.tip: Face away from a low cable, hinge until the hands pass between the legs, then snap the hips forward while keeping the ribs stacked.

legs.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
legs.tip: Use the balls of the feet on the platform, keep knees softly unlocked, and earn a full stretch before every hard squeeze.

legs.name: Donkey Calf Raise (Machine)
legs.tip: Let the heels sink below the step, then rise as high as possible without bouncing. Keep each rep controlled.

legs.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
legs.tip: Keep the back secure on the pad, use a controlled deep range, and press through the whole foot without locking the knees.

shoulders.name: Barbell Overhead Press
shoulders.tip: Bar at chin level, press straight up and slightly back. Core and glutes tight throughout.

shoulders.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
shoulders.tip: Press straight up, elbows ~75° to the body. Don't lock out — keep tension on the delts.

shoulders.name: Arnold Press
shoulders.tip: Start palms facing you, rotate out as you press. Hits all three delt heads.

shoulders.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Lead with the elbows, slight bend. Raise to shoulder height only. Go light, feel the burn.

shoulders.name: Cable Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Constant tension across the whole range. One arm at a time for a stricter stretch.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.tip: Bend forward 45°, raise elbows to shoulder height. Critical for posture and balance.

shoulders.name: Reverse Pec Deck
shoulders.tip: Machine rear-delt fly. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the rear delts together.

shoulders.name: Cable Front Raise
shoulders.tip: Raise to eye level, keep the core tight. Front delts also get hit by all your pressing.

shoulders.name: Upright Row
shoulders.tip: EZ-bar or cable, pull to chin level with elbows high. Works traps and side delts.

shoulders.name: Machine Shoulder Press
shoulders.tip: Set the seat so handles begin around ear height. Press up with the ribs down and keep the upper back against the pad.

shoulders.name: Smith Machine Overhead Press
shoulders.tip: Use a bench with back support and position the bar just in front of the face. Brace the core before each controlled press.

shoulders.name: Machine Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Set the pads just above the elbows. Lead outward with the elbows, pause near shoulder height, and lower slowly.

shoulders.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
shoulders.tip: Raise one or both dumbbells to shoulder height without leaning back. Keep the movement smooth and the load modest.

shoulders.name: Plate Front Raise
shoulders.tip: Grip a small plate at three and nine o'clock, lift it to eye level, and stay tall without swinging from the hips.

shoulders.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.tip: Use crossed handles at shoulder height. Sweep the arms apart with a soft elbow while keeping the neck relaxed.

shoulders.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise
shoulders.tip: Hinge until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor, then raise elbows wide. Do not shrug the shoulders toward the ears.

shoulders.name: Leaning Cable Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Hold the upright with the free hand and start the cable slightly behind the body. Let the cable load the bottom range.

shoulders.name: High-Incline Dumbbell Press
shoulders.tip: Use a 70–80 degree bench angle. Keep forearms vertical and press in a comfortable scapular plane, not straight out wide.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Row
shoulders.tip: Use a wide elbow path and row toward the upper chest. Keep the torso fixed so the rear delts and upper back drive the movement.

biceps.name: Barbell Curl
biceps.tip: Elbows pinned at your sides. Full range, no swinging. The primary bicep mass builder.

biceps.name: EZ-Bar Curl
biceps.tip: Angled grip is easier on the wrists. Heavy and strict — keep elbows fixed.

biceps.name: Dumbbell Curl
biceps.tip: Supinate (turn pinky up) at the top for a full peak contraction. Alternate or together.

biceps.name: Hammer Curl
biceps.tip: Neutral grip (thumbs up). Builds the brachialis for arm thickness. Full range.

biceps.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
biceps.tip: Arms hang behind you on an incline bench. Maximum stretch for the bicep peak.

biceps.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
biceps.tip: Bench enforces strict form — no cheating. Full range on the pad for peak isolation.

biceps.name: Concentration Curl
biceps.tip: Seated, elbow braced on the inner thigh. The ultimate single-arm peak builder.

biceps.name: Cable Curl
biceps.tip: Constant tension top to bottom. Great finisher — slow and controlled reps.

biceps.name: Machine Preacher Curl
biceps.tip: Set the seat so the armpits rest against the pad. Fully lengthen the biceps at the bottom without snapping the elbow straight.

biceps.name: Standing Machine Curl
biceps.tip: Keep the chest against the support and curl without lifting the elbows. Use the machine's stability to keep every rep strict.

biceps.name: Cable Hammer Curl (Rope)
biceps.tip: Use a rope on a low cable and keep palms facing each other. Curl toward the shoulders with the elbows pinned to the sides.

biceps.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
biceps.tip: Face away from a low cable with the working arm slightly behind the torso. Curl without letting the shoulder drift forward.

biceps.name: Spider Curl
biceps.tip: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and let the arms hang straight. Curl with no shoulder swing and squeeze at the top.

biceps.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
biceps.tip: Bring the dumbbell diagonally toward the opposite shoulder with a neutral grip. Keep the upper arm close to the body.

biceps.name: Incline Hammer Curl
biceps.tip: Use an incline bench with palms facing each other. Let the arms hang behind the torso, then curl without moving the elbows forward.

biceps.name: Reverse EZ-Bar Curl
biceps.tip: Use an overhand grip with wrists neutral. Curl smoothly without swinging to train the brachialis and forearms.

triceps.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
triceps.tip: Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked. The heavy compound mass builder for triceps.

triceps.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
triceps.tip: Lock elbows at your sides, push to full extension. Rope or straight bar.

triceps.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
triceps.tip: Dumbbell overhead, lower slowly behind the head. Best stretch for the long head.

triceps.name: Skull Crushers (EZ Bar)
triceps.tip: Lower the bar toward your forehead, elbows fixed at the ceiling. Great mass builder.

triceps.name: Tricep Dips
triceps.tip: Stay upright to bias the triceps. Elbows point back, not out. Control the descent.

triceps.name: Bench Dips
triceps.tip: Hands on a bench behind you, feet forward. Lower until 90°. Beginner-friendly.

triceps.name: Diamond Push-Ups
triceps.tip: Hands together under the chest forming a diamond. Tricep-focused push-up.

triceps.name: Tricep Kickback
triceps.tip: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor. Extend and squeeze at the top.

triceps.name: Assisted Dip Machine
triceps.tip: Stay upright and keep the elbows traveling back to bias triceps. Choose enough assistance to control the bottom range.

triceps.name: Machine Tricep Extension
triceps.tip: Set the pivot in line with the elbows, press through a smooth range, and keep the upper arms planted on the pad.

triceps.name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
triceps.tip: Keep elbows close to the ribs and split the rope slightly at the bottom. Let the forearms return only until tension stays on the triceps.

triceps.name: Reverse-Grip Tricep Pushdown
triceps.tip: Use a light straight bar with palms up. Lock the elbows by the sides and press down without rolling the shoulders forward.

triceps.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
triceps.tip: Stand square to a high cable and keep the upper arm still. Press the handle down until the elbow is straight, then control the return.

triceps.name: Overhead Rope Tricep Extension
triceps.tip: Face away from a low cable, let the rope stretch behind the head, then extend without letting the elbows flare too wide.

triceps.name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Extension
triceps.tip: Set the cable low, face away, and keep the elbow pointing forward. Extend smoothly while the torso stays stacked.

triceps.name: Lying Dumbbell Tricep Extension
triceps.tip: Lie on a flat bench, lower the dumbbells beside the head with elbows pointed up, then extend smoothly without letting the shoulders drift.

triceps.name: EZ-Bar Overhead Extension
triceps.tip: Keep the elbows facing forward and lower the bar behind the head under control. Extend until the triceps are straight without arching the back.

core.name: Plank
core.tip: Squeeze glutes AND abs. Don't let the hips sag or rise. Breathe normally.

core.name: Side Plank
core.tip: Stack the feet, lift the hips, body in a straight line. Builds the obliques. Each side.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
core.tip: Dead hang, posterior pelvic tilt at the top. No swinging — use the abs, not momentum.

core.name: Lying Leg Raise
core.tip: On your back, press the lower back into the floor. Lower legs slowly without arching.

core.name: Crunch
core.tip: Curl the ribs toward the hips, don't yank the neck. Pause and squeeze at the top.

core.name: Bicycle Crunch
core.tip: Opposite elbow to knee, slow and controlled. Rotate from the torso for the obliques.

core.name: Russian Twist
core.tip: Lean back, feet off the floor. Rotate from the torso. Hold a plate to progress.

core.name: Mountain Climbers
core.tip: Plank position, drive the knees to the chest quickly. Keep the hips low and core tight.

core.name: Dead Bug
core.tip: Press the lower back into the floor. Move the opposite arm and leg slowly. Great stability.

core.name: Cable Crunch
core.tip: Kneel at the cable, crunch ribs to hips. Keep the hips still. Builds ab thickness.

core.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
core.tip: Start from the knees, roll out until flat, pull back with the abs. Best ab strength move.

core.name: Decline Sit-Up
core.tip: Full range on a decline bench. Hold a plate at the chest to progress.

core.name: Machine Crunch
core.tip: Set the pad so the ribs can curl toward the pelvis. Move through the spine rather than just pulling down with the arms.

core.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
core.tip: Press the forearms into the pads, keep the back supported, and curl the knees up with a small pelvic tuck at the top.

core.name: Cable Wood Chop
core.tip: Rotate through the upper body while keeping the hips stable. Finish with the hands outside the opposite hip and control the return.

core.name: Pallof Press
core.tip: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable, press the handle straight out, and resist the pull to rotate. Keep ribs stacked over the pelvis.

core.name: Weighted Plank
core.tip: Use a light plate placed securely over the upper back. Keep the same straight, braced position as a bodyweight plank.

core.name: Reverse Crunch
core.tip: Start with knees bent and curl the pelvis off the floor. Keep the movement small and slow instead of swinging the legs.

core.name: V-Up
core.tip: Reach hands and feet toward each other while keeping the motion controlled. Scale by bending the knees if the lower back arches.

core.name: Stability Ball Crunch
core.tip: Support the low back on the ball, keep feet planted, and curl the ribs down without letting the ball roll away.

core.name: Machine Torso Rotation
core.tip: Set the pads snugly, rotate through a comfortable range, and return slowly. Use the obliques instead of forcing the hip position.

core.name: Suitcase Carry
core.tip: Hold one dumbbell at your side, walk slowly without leaning, and keep the shoulders level. Switch hands each set.

core.name: Farmer Carry
core.tip: Carry heavy dumbbells or kettlebells with tall posture, short controlled steps, and a tight brace from start to finish.

core.name: Toe Touch Crunch
core.tip: Keep legs pointed toward the ceiling, lift the shoulder blades, and reach toward the toes without pulling the neck.

cardio.name: Treadmill Run
cardio.tip: Set a pace you can hold to the end. Land under your hips, don't reach with the heel.

cardio.name: Treadmill Incline Walk
cardio.tip: 10–12% incline, 5–6 km/h, hands off the rails. Brutal on the calves, easy on the knees.

cardio.name: Stationary Bike
cardio.tip: Saddle at hip height so the knee stays soft at the bottom. Spin, don't grind.

cardio.name: Assault Bike
cardio.tip: Push and pull with the arms as hard as the legs. The fan punishes pacing mistakes.

cardio.name: Rowing Machine
cardio.tip: Legs, then hips, then arms — reverse it on the way back. The legs do most of the work.

cardio.name: Ski Erg
cardio.tip: Drive from the lats and hinge at the hips. It's a crunch with the arms, not an arm pull.

cardio.name: Elliptical
cardio.tip: Keep the heels down and let the legs lead. Raise the ramp to bias the glutes.

cardio.name: Stair Climber
cardio.tip: Stand tall, light touch on the rails. Leaning on the handles cuts the work in half.

cardio.name: Jump Rope
cardio.tip: Small wrist circles, low hops. Rest between rounds — this is an interval, not a grind.

cardio.name: Battle Ropes
cardio.tip: Stay in a quarter squat and keep the waves reaching the anchor. Short, hard rounds.

cardio.name: Recumbent Bike
cardio.tip: Adjust the seat so the knee remains softly bent at full extension. Keep a smooth cadence instead of mashing a heavy gear.

cardio.name: Spin Bike
cardio.tip: Set saddle height around hip level and keep a light grip on the handlebars. Match resistance to a cadence you can control.

cardio.name: Arc Trainer
cardio.tip: Stay tall with a quiet upper body, push evenly through both feet, and use the ramp setting to find a sustainable effort.

cardio.name: VersaClimber
cardio.tip: Use a long, coordinated reach with opposite arm and leg. Start at a manageable pace before increasing the climb rate.

cardio.name: Air Runner
cardio.tip: Keep the body tall and let the curved deck guide your stride. Move forward on the deck to accelerate and back to slow down.

cardio.name: Treadmill Sprint Intervals
cardio.tip: Use hard but repeatable work intervals with full walking recovery. Step onto the side rails only after the belt has slowed.

cardio.name: Rowing Intervals
cardio.tip: Drive powerfully with the legs first, then the hips and arms. Recover in reverse order and keep every stroke smooth.

cardio.name: Sled Push
cardio.tip: Brace the trunk, keep arms straight, and drive short powerful steps through the floor. Choose a load that keeps the hips from shooting up.

cardio.name: Sled Pull
cardio.tip: Face the sled or walk backward with controlled steps. Keep constant tension on the strap and maintain a tall, braced torso.

cardio.name: Kettlebell Swing
cardio.tip: Hinge at the hips, snap the glutes to float the bell, and let it return between the legs. It is a hip hinge, not a squat.

cardio.name: Medicine Ball Slam
cardio.tip: Reach tall, brace the trunk, then slam the ball directly in front of you. Pick it up with a hinge rather than a rounded back.

cardio.name: Burpees
cardio.tip: Keep the push-up and jump controlled. Step the feet back or forward to scale the movement while preserving a steady pace.

cardio.name: Box Jumps
cardio.tip: Choose a box you can land on quietly. Swing the arms, jump with both feet, stand tall on top, and step down to reset.

chest.name: Barbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Arch slightly, feet flat. Bar touches lower chest. Drive up and slightly back. Best compound for chest mass.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: 30–45° bench angle. Lower dumbbells until elbows go just below bench height. Upper chest focus.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.tip: Body in a straight line. Elbows at 45° from torso — not flared at 90°. Great finisher.

back.name: Barbell Row
back.tip: Hinge at hips ~45°. Pull bar to belly button. Squeeze shoulder blades hard at top. Back stays flat.

back.name: Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Lean back slightly, pull bar to upper chest. Fully extend arms at top for full lat stretch.

back.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
back.tip: Dead hang at the bottom. Pull chest toward the bar. Control the lowering — 2 seconds down.

legs.name: Barbell Back Squat
legs.tip: Bar on upper traps, chest up. Knees track toes. Hip crease BELOW knees at the bottom. King of all exercises.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlift (DB)
legs.tip: Push hips BACK — not down. This is a hip hinge, not a squat. Feel hamstring stretch. Back stays neutral.

legs.name: Walking Lunges
legs.tip: Big step forward. Front shin stays vertical. Back knee nearly touches the floor. Step through, don't rock.

shoulders.name: Barbell Overhead Press
shoulders.tip: Bar starts at chin level. Press straight up, slightly back at top. Keep core and glutes tight throughout.

shoulders.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Lead with elbows, slight bend. Raise to shoulder height only. Go lighter than you think — feel the burn.

arms.name: Barbell Curl
arms.tip: Elbows pinned at sides. Full range of motion — all the way down and all the way up. No swinging.

arms.name: Tricep Dips (Bench)
arms.tip: Hands on bench behind you, feet forward. Elbows point BACK not out. Lower until 90°. Keep chest up.

arms.name: Hammer Curl
arms.tip: Neutral grip (thumbs up). Works brachialis for arm thickness. Alternate arms, full range.

core.name: Plank
core.tip: Squeeze glutes AND abs at the same time. Don't let hips sag or rise. Breathe normally.

core.name: Dead Bug
core.tip: Press lower back into floor throughout. Move OPPOSITE arm and leg slowly. Best core stability exercise.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
core.tip: Full dead hang. Posterior pelvic tilt at the top for full ab contraction. Control the descent.

chest.name: Barbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Arch slightly, feet flat. Bar touches lower chest. Drive through the sticking point — don't grind slowly.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: 30–45° incline. PPL means more chest volume — focus upper chest. Lower until elbows go below bench level.

chest.name: Cable Chest Fly
chest.tip: High cables. Slight bend in elbows throughout. Arc motion, squeeze hard at center. Keep shoulder blades back.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.tip: Great burnout finisher. Can add a weight plate on back to progress. Elbows at 45°, full range.

shoulders.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
shoulders.tip: Press straight up. Elbows at ~75° to body. Don't lock out fully — keep tension on delts.

shoulders.name: Lateral Raises
shoulders.tip: PPL gets high shoulder volume. Use lighter weight and feel every rep. Lead with elbows, not wrists.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.tip: Bend forward 45°. Raise elbows to shoulder height. Rear delts are critical for posture and shoulder health.

shoulders.name: Cable Front Raise
shoulders.tip: Single cable, alternate arms. Raise to eye level. Keep core tight. Front delts get worked by pressing too.

triceps.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
triceps.tip: Lock elbows at sides. Push all the way to full extension. Rope or straight bar.

triceps.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
triceps.tip: Dumbbell overhead. Lower slowly behind head. Best for long tricep head stretch.

triceps.name: Tricep Dips
triceps.tip: Stay upright for tricep focus. Elbows back. Control the descent.

biceps.name: Barbell / EZ-Bar Curl
biceps.tip: Heavy and strict. No swinging. Elbows pinned at sides. Full range of motion.

biceps.name: Hammer Curl
biceps.tip: Neutral grip. Works brachialis for arm girth. Alternate arms, full range.

biceps.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
biceps.tip: Arms hang behind you on incline bench. Maximum stretch at bottom for peak.

back.name: Deadlift
back.tip: Bar over mid-foot. Neutral spine. Push the floor away — don't think of it as pulling. Biggest strength builder.

back.name: Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Wide grip for lat width. Lean back slightly. Pull to upper chest. Fully extend at top every rep.

back.name: Seated Cable Row
back.tip: Chest up, sit tall. Pull handle to belly button. Squeeze shoulder blades and hold 1 second at peak.

back.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
back.tip: Row to your hip — not your shoulder. Elbow tracks close to body. Keep back flat.

back.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
back.tip: Dead hang at bottom. Pull chest to the bar. The single best exercise for lat width.

back.name: Face Pulls
back.tip: Cable at eye height. Pull rope to forehead, elbows flared HIGH. Essential for shoulder health and posture.

legs.name: Barbell Back Squat
legs.tip: High bar or low bar — your choice. Knees track toes. Go below parallel if mobility allows. Breathe in on the way down.

legs.name: Leg Press (Machine)
legs.tip: Feet shoulder-width. Press through heels. Don't lock knees at top. High foot = more hamstrings.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlift
legs.tip: Hip hinge. Push hips back slowly. Feel every inch of hamstring stretch. 2–3 second eccentric.

legs.name: Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: 3-second negative. Don't let hips rise off the pad. Full range of motion for hamstring health.

legs.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
legs.tip: Pause and squeeze at the top. Quad isolation finisher. Don't use too much weight — feel the contraction.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
legs.tip: Full stretch at the bottom. Pause and squeeze at the top every single rep. Calves need high reps.

core.name: Cable Crunch
core.tip: Kneel at cable. Crunch ribs TO hips — not head to knees. Keep hips still. Heavy cable crunch builds ab thickness.

core.name: Plank
core.tip: Posterior pelvic tilt slightly. Squeeze abs and glutes. Breathe normally. Increase duration over time.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
core.tip: Dead hang. Raise legs to parallel or higher. No swinging — use ab contraction, not momentum.

core.name: Russian Twist
core.tip: Lean back slightly, feet off floor. Rotate from torso, not just arms. Add a dumbbell for progression.

chest.name: Barbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Upper/Lower allows heavier pressing. Control the descent 2–3 sec. Explosive press up. Shoulder blades stay retracted.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: Upper chest emphasis. Keep dumbbells in line with lower chest. Full range of motion.

chest.name: Dumbbell Flat Fly
chest.tip: Light weight. Arc motion. Feel the chest stretch at the bottom. Slight elbow bend throughout.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.tip: Great burnout finisher at the end of chest work. Elevate feet for upper chest focus.

back.name: Barbell Row
back.tip: Hinge at hips. Pull bar to navel. Chest stays up. The back mass builder — treat it like a deadlift for the upper back.

back.name: Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Wide grip for back width. Pull to upper chest. Feel each lat independently.

back.name: Cable Row
back.tip: Vary the grip each session (wide, narrow, neutral) for complete back development.

back.name: Face Pulls
back.tip: High pulley, pull to forehead with external rotation. Non-negotiable for shoulder health. Every upper day.

back.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
back.tip: Full dead hang at the bottom. Chin over bar at the top. Best lat width exercise.

legs.name: Barbell Back Squat
legs.tip: Primary quad and glute driver. Controlled descent. Explode up through heels.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlift
legs.tip: Hip hinge pattern. Push hips back. Feel hamstrings load under tension. Back neutral throughout.

legs.name: Leg Press
legs.tip: Great quad volume after squats. Vary foot placement each session for different emphasis.

legs.name: Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: Slow eccentric (3 sec). Vital for hamstring health and knee injury prevention.

legs.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
legs.tip: Rear foot elevated on bench. Front foot far forward. One of the best quad and glute exercises. Brutal but effective.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
legs.tip: Pause at top. Full stretch at bottom. Calves are used to bodyweight daily — they need serious volume.

shoulders.name: Barbell Overhead Press
shoulders.tip: Heavy compound shoulder work. Bar starts at chin. Press straight up. Keep core braced.

shoulders.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
shoulders.tip: Side delt isolation. Can do seated for stricter form. Lead with elbows, not wrists.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.tip: Bent-over or on incline bench. Rear delts are typically undertrained — critical for shoulder balance.

shoulders.name: Arnold Press
shoulders.tip: Start with palms facing you, rotate outward as you press. Hits all 3 heads of the deltoid.

arms.name: Barbell Curl
arms.tip: Standing strict curl. Full range of motion. Keep elbows pinned. No body sway.

arms.name: Skull Crushers (EZ Bar)
arms.tip: Lower bar toward forehead carefully. Elbows stay fixed pointing at ceiling. Great tricep mass builder.

arms.name: Hammer Curl
arms.tip: Neutral grip. Adds brachialis thickness. Alternate arms, full range.

arms.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
arms.tip: Lock elbows at sides. Full extension every rep. Rope vs. bar changes the feel — try both.

core.name: Plank
core.tip: Squeeze every muscle. Quality beats duration. Posterior pelvic tilt for better ab activation.

core.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
core.tip: Start from knees. Roll out until back is flat. Pull back using abs — not arms. Best ab exercise for strength.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
core.tip: Posterior pelvic tilt at the top for full rectus abdominis contraction. Control the descent.

core.name: Cable Crunch
core.tip: Round your back. Crunch ribs to hips. Controlled movement throughout. Great for lower ab thickness.

chest.name: Barbell Bench Press
chest.tip: Primary mass builder. Vary grip width (wide hits outer chest, closer hits inner). Own the bench press.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.tip: Upper chest often lags — prioritize this. 30–45° angle. Dumbbells allow deeper stretch.

chest.name: Decline Barbell Press
chest.tip: Slight decline (15–30°). Hits the lower chest for full chest development. Often skipped but very effective.

chest.name: Cable Chest Fly
chest.tip: High cables. Squeeze hard at the center. Constant tension throughout the motion. Great isolation.

chest.name: Dumbbell Flat Fly
chest.tip: Deep stretch at the bottom. Go light — form first. Feel the chest open up on every rep.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.tip: Burnout finisher after heavy pressing. Elevate feet for upper chest. Elbows at 45°.

back.name: Deadlift
back.tip: Heaviest compound. Drive the floor away. Don't jerk the bar. Biggest overall strength builder.

back.name: Barbell Row
back.tip: Overhand grip. Pull to navel. Squeeze shoulder blades at top. Heaviest back exercise after deadlift.

back.name: Lat Pulldown
back.tip: Wide grip for width. Feel each lat pull down independently. Don't use momentum.

back.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
back.tip: Heavy. Row elbow past your torso level. Full range of motion. Back flat.

back.name: Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up
back.tip: Add a weight belt as you get stronger. Ultimate lat exercise. Full hang to chin over bar.

back.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
back.tip: Arms stay straight. Pull the bar to your thighs. Pure lat isolation. Great mind-muscle connection.

back.name: Face Pulls
back.tip: Never skip these. External rotation and rear delt work. Pull to ears with elbows high and wide.

legs.name: Barbell Back Squat
legs.tip: King of exercises. Proper form over heavy weight. Knees track toes. Hip crease below parallel.

legs.name: Leg Press (Machine)
legs.tip: High foot placement hits glutes/hamstrings. Low foot placement hits quads. Vary each session.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlift
legs.tip: Slow, controlled hip hinge. Feel every inch of hamstring stretch. 3-second eccentric.

legs.name: Leg Curl (Machine)
legs.tip: 3-second eccentric. Don't let hips lift. Complete hamstring isolation.

legs.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
legs.tip: Pause and squeeze quad at the top every rep. Great isolation finisher after squats.

legs.name: Walking Lunges
legs.tip: Big step. Front shin stays vertical. Glute stretch at bottom. Functional and highly effective.

legs.name: Standing Calf Raises
legs.tip: Calves are stubborn — they need high frequency and FULL ROM. Pause at top, stretch at bottom.

shoulders.name: Barbell Overhead Press
shoulders.tip: Strict press, no leg drive. The shoulder strength and size builder. Keep core and glutes tight.

shoulders.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
shoulders.tip: Greater range of motion than barbell. Let dumbbells come down beside your ears at the bottom.

shoulders.name: Lateral Raises
shoulders.tip: High lateral delt volume. Cables + dumbbells in same session gives constant tension variety.

shoulders.name: Rear Delt Fly
shoulders.tip: Bent-over or on incline bench. High reps. Rear delts severely underworked in most programs.

shoulders.name: Upright Row
shoulders.tip: EZ-bar or cable. Pull to chin level. Elbows flare wide and high. Works traps and lateral delts.

shoulders.name: Face Pulls
shoulders.tip: Always include for shoulder health. External rotation under load keeps rotator cuffs healthy.

arms.name: Barbell Curl
arms.tip: Heavy and strict. The primary bicep mass builder. Supinate wrist fully at the top.

arms.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
arms.tip: Full stretch at the bottom. Supinate at the top. Great for bicep peak development.

arms.name: Hammer Curl
arms.tip: Neutral grip. Brachialis and forearm thickness. Alternate arms, controlled movement.

arms.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
arms.tip: Bench enforces strict form. No cheating possible. Full range on the pad for peak isolation.

arms.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
arms.tip: Lock elbows at sides — they don't move. Full extension on every rep. Rope or straight bar.

arms.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
arms.tip: Long head of tricep. Dumbbell or EZ-bar. Control the eccentric. Best tricep stretch.

arms.name: Tricep Dips
arms.tip: Stay upright to target triceps (lean forward = chest). Can add weight with a dipping belt.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raise
core.tip: Dead hang. Posterior pelvic tilt. Raise legs above parallel. Weighted if you can do 20 easily.

core.name: Cable Crunch
core.tip: Heavy cable crunch builds ab thickness. Round your back. Ribs to hips every rep.

core.name: Plank
core.tip: Add a weight plate on your back to progress. Maximum core tension.

core.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
core.tip: Best overall ab exercise. Works entire core. Control both directions. Advance to standing rollout.

core.name: Russian Twist
core.tip: Hold a weight plate or medicine ball. Rotate from torso. Oblique focus.

core.name: Decline Sit-Up
core.tip: Full range. Hold a weight plate at chest for progression. Classic ab builder.
